segments.name: Automotive aftermarket parts
segments.description: Specialty retailer of automotive aftermarket parts, tools, supplies, equipment, and accessories to DIY and professional service provider customers.
segments.evidence: O'Reilly is one of the largest specialty retailers of automotive aftermarket parts, tools, supplies, equipment, and accessories across North America, selling our products to both do-it-yourself ("DIY") and professional service provider customers, our "dual market strategy."

revenueModel.text: The company sells automotive aftermarket parts and accessories to do-it-yourself customers and professional service provider customers through physical stores and online platforms.
revenueModel.evidence: Product sales of automotive aftermarket parts are the only material source of revenue for the Company.
